body.name: bounded legal covariance class
body.construction: \(\Theta_K=\{\zeta_{d,E,r}:mI_d\preceq Z_e\preceq MI_d\text{ for every }e\in\mathcal E;\ \operatorname{rank}(\sum_{f=1}^E(Z_f-Z_0))=r;\ \operatorname{range}(Z_e-Z_0)\subseteq\operatorname{range}(\sum_{f=1}^E(Z_f-Z_0))\text{ for every }1\le e\le E;\ \exists T,t\text{ with }|T|=r\text{ and }\operatorname{Cert}(\zeta,T,t)\}\).
